description: Hydroinfo is the website of the Hungarian Hydrological Forecasting Service, founded in 1892 and part of the General Directorate of Water Management since 2012. Its tasks are to acquire, process and deliver current hydrological data, hydrological forecasts, shallow-section information for navigation, meteorological observations and forecasts, and snow and river ice data. The site shows 30-day water level graphs for the Danube, Tisza, Drava and Mura with flood alert stages, a daily map, daily tables for rivers and lakes, forecasts and a test warning system for small catchments. The archive holds tables of morning water levels at selected gauges from the start of records, with ice codes and monthly and annual statistics. Coverage is Hungary and upstream Danube basin stations used for forecasting. Access is free online as web tables and graphs. Caveats: the legal notice reserves all rights and requires prior written permission for reuse or database inclusion, and annual tables are raw operational data. Simulation uses: flood warning, forcing and calibration of river models, and navigation planning. Related records: PEGELONLINE (data-pegelonline-federal-waterways-water-levels) and FOEN hydrological data (data-foen-switzerland-hydrological-data-and-forecasts).
